purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for the Cistern House Nine water-note fixture.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for ordinary invoice work, preparatory choices, the collar failure and refusal notice, service responses, the shared cost ledger, and state-gated aftermaths.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the room, participant introduction, material terms and first choices, the routine fold, the isolated collar break, the response choices, the shared consequence frame, and each ending family. Branch modifiers carry visible deltas into folded frames.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Every base image prompt is a complete standalone frame for a general image model. It restates visible geometry, materials, lighting, bodies, tools, and object state. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints and are excluded from prompt assembly.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: richly textured high-fantasy industrial storybook illustration in a Faerun-like register, precise etched ink lines with restrained painterly gouache, worn basalt and carved stone, hammered brass and dark iron, warm amber oil lamps against cold blue mana light, readable silhouettes, humane facial acting, practical rune machinery, unlettered slates carrying abstract chalk marks and seal shapes, cinematic composition for illustrated interactive fiction.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble each image prompt from the global_style_cue, the scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for named characters or groups actually visible in that frame, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Do not rely on prior generated images for room memory.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: This fixture reuses the established Cistern House Nine two-level text layout and adds fixed accounting-ledger, crystal-bin, vendor-crate, old-gauge, and header-tank state anchors.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Before high-consistency website rendering, turn the shared text layout into a plan view or simple 3D blockout with the listed camera and staging slots.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide view from a stone street landing into an empty compact two-level underground pump house. The dry upper rune gallery has amber oil lamps, a yellow public boundary, a black slate, a tall terrace water gauge, a brass safety rail, an accounting ledge, and a grated stair descending to a wet chamber filled with warm mist and black seawater. Three squat brass-and-iron pump engines stand west-to-east below the rail, each with a vertical glass pressure float, outlet pipe, dark rune slate, and rectangular wedge throat. A locked riveted conduit arch in the north wall carries cold blue mana toward the pump row. Four copper-bound crystal bins and one gray iron parts crate sit beside the accounting ledge. The maintained room is visibly dependent on fuel and records.
visual_continuity_notes: Public landing is west, dry gallery is above, wet intake is below, three pumps run west-to-east, and the municipal conduit enters the north wall.
The accounting ledge, four crystal bins, gray parts crate, and old brass collar gauge occupy the upper gallery, not a second room.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Medium-wide morning work tableau in the dry gallery of a two-level fantasy pump house. A young adult dwarf apprentice with warm brown skin, one thick dark-copper braid, indigo sleeveless work coat, leather apron, heavy boots, and chalk-stained square fingers sets calibrated brass weights beside a low iron roller scale carrying four squat copper-bound crystal bins. A very short square-shouldered middle-aged dwarf Master with deep brown skin, cropped iron-gray hair, dark green wool coat, and a heavy stepped-water civic seal on a chain compares a red-cord contract sheet with a black public slate. The clerk holding the slate is a sturdy middle-aged dwarf with pale olive skin, rust-red headscarf, charcoal vest, striped brown shirt, and chalk holster. A stocky dwarf journeyworker with ruddy tan skin, forked auburn beard, rolled slate-blue sleeves, and oil-dark apron kneels beside a scarred metal drive collar. A gray iron replacement-parts crate sealed by a taut red cord waits behind the brass rail; three pumps and the terrace gauge remain visible.

visible_characters.default_stance: at the balance scale beside the crystal bins
at the accounting ledge with seal and contract sheet
kneeling beside the scarred collar and old gauge
holding the public slate beside Hessa

visual_continuity_notes: This frame introduces all named participants before later folds depend on them.
The red cord belongs to the gray certified-parts crate and stays intact unless borrow_for_water is selected.

state_image_modifiers.modifier_prompt: All active outlet pipes run strongly and the terrace gauge rises above red while relief moves through the vessel queue.

All pressure floats are low, the pumps are dark, the public spout is dry, and the terrace gauge rests in red.
The red cord is cut, Hessa's fresh seal impression sits on the accelerated amendment, and the winter-priority row is posted on the public slate.
The recut collar runs on Engine Two beside the old brass gauge while a heavy black chalk stroke cancels the warranty row.
Only one shallow copper-bound crystal bin remains while three empty bin mouths face the viewer.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide open district moot in a carved-stone terrace hall. A young dwarf apprentice with dark-copper braid and indigo work coat carries a bundle of metal-sealed route tickets and an insurance refusal. A middle-aged dwarf clerk in a rust-red headscarf carries a large black public slate. Around a low basalt table sit and stand compact dwarf representatives from liftworks, kitchens, laundries, a crystal reserve house, and two route offices; their work clothes, lifting gloves, flour aprons, laundry sleeves, locked crystal coffer, route maps, and distinct civic seals make each interest visually legible. Copper water cans and one bakery trough line the rear wall. Workshop documents on the table carry a stepped-water seal impression.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide stepped underground terrace street outside Cistern House Nine. Carved stone stairs climb past a public spout, a tall water gauge, an elevated riveted header tank with float bells, bakery doors, a laundry arch, a bathhouse sign carved as a simple basin symbol, and an infirmary doorway marked by a lamp. A young dwarf apprentice with dark-copper braid and indigo work coat carries two hammered-copper cans on a wooden yoke. A rust-headscarf dwarf clerk marks remaining water bands on a portable black slate. Dwarves in flour-marked aprons, rolled laundry sleeves, infirmary smocks, and patched terrace clothes wait with copper cans, ceramic jugs, kettles, and one wheeled bakery trough. The rising stairs make upper-street distance and carrying labor visually explicit.

Left Engine One and right Engine Three run with intensely bright blue channels and high pressure floats while central Engine Two remains dark; crystal bins stand rapidly emptied and Orsa keeps watch beside a whining right-hand casing.
All red isolation wedges sit fully seated, every pressure float is low, Dema's slate shows the refusal clause beside the falling gauge, and empty vessels become prominent beyond the yellow line.
Orsa and Dema place route tickets, refusal notice, public slate, creditor claim, and water levels before separate trade and route seals around one low table.
The old brass gauge, recut dimensions, inspection interval, files, training board, and Hessa's seal form one inspectable local maintenance station.
Restored water flow, cut creditor cord, bright certified collar, fresh seal, remaining crystal stock, and posted winter-priority claim all share the frame.
Water vessels, street-height bands, trade tools, header-tank level, public spout, and carrying route up the stairs make remaining water time visible by street and use.

review_notes: Visual continuity self-review verdict: accepted_with_minor_revisions as an illustrated-IF scaffold. Eleven base scenes, twelve branch modifiers, complete visible-character refs, affirmative standalone prompts, and stable object states cover the playable replay; high-consistency multi-angle art still requires a plan view or blockout.

Spatial-geometric self-review verdict: accepted_with_minor_revisions as a stageable text plan. The inherited two-level Cistern House Nine layout now includes reachable accounting, roller-scale, part-custody, public-slate, service, moot, and ration routes with fixed cameras, staging slots, occluders, and branch-state anchors.
